scope: Proposition 10.2 (Marked-grid moment estimate) of the manuscript “Signed tensor densities and diagram budgets for the Thorp shuffle” (preprints/Signed-tensor-densities-and-diagram-budgets-for-coordinate-sweeps-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 69f29b044ee825ef), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 74. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Say that a diagram fits the q-hook if all cells belong to its first q rows or its first q columns. Write em(l) = l log(m/l), with em(0) = 0. Fix θ = 1/2, c0 = 1/100. Consider n = ab ≥ 2, where a, b are powers of two with log2 a, log2 b differing by at most one, and q ≤ n1/16 a positive integer. Let p ≥ 2 be real and let Ba, Bb ≥ 0. Suppose that, for each m ∈ {a, b}, every diagram ξ ⊢ m, and every q-hook subdiagram η ⊆ ξ of size m − l, log Jm(ξ, p) ≤ Bm + θHη + c0 log(m)l − em(l), (95) using −∞ for log zero. Then for every λ ⊢ n and every q-hook subdiagram ω ⊆ λ of size g = n − t, log Jn(λ, p) ≤ θHω +c0 log(n)t−en(t)+aBb +bBa +O ( t+(a+b)(q2 +n1/4 ) log(n+1) ) , (96) The implicit constant is absolute.
